Container.Name: slack-events-listener
Container.Overview: Slack Events listener. Receives DMs and app mentions from Slack and writes them to an inbox JSONL file for downstream consumers.

Config.Name: TCP bind address
Config.Description: Address and port to bind in host network mode. Use 127.0.0.1 so nginx can proxy, or 0.0.0.0 for external access.

Config.Name: Inbox directory
Config.Description: Directory where inbox.jsonl is stored. Mount this to a host directory.

Config.Name: Slack signing secret
Config.Description: Your Slack app signing secret. Mount a secrets file to /run/secrets/slack_signing_secret, /data/slack_signing_secret, or /config/slack_signing_secret, or enter it here.

Config.Name: Allowed Slack user ID
Config.Description: Only DMs from this Slack user ID are recorded. Leave empty to allow all DMs.

Config.Name: Slack bot user ID
Config.Description: Optional: your Slack bot's user ID, so it ignores its own messages
